The company this morning announced the repurchase of $193 million of STRC, bringing total buybacks to nearly $2 billion. Strategy also announced an increase in the authorized buyback amount to $3 billion from $2 billion. Recall that the buyback program started this past summer following STRC plunging nearly all the way to $70, putting in question the future of the security.
